Ben / team — technical notes for the MAP and the security review: 

- Manifest format: JSON-LD wrapper with fields {image_name, image_sha256, build_id, builder_id, release_timestamp, attestations[]}. We should provide a small example.
- Signing: ECDSA-P256 with certificate chain; private keys stored in FIPS 140-2 Level 3 HSM for Redwood-managed signing. For customer-hosted signing we support PKCS#11 interface and can consume a customer cert (we validate the cert chain).
- Key rotation: recommend 6-month cadence with quarterly automated healthchecks. Emergency revoke + re-sign flow documented; signed delta manifests supported to minimize bandwidth for site installs.
- Transport: signed-manifest-v1.tar.gz (tar+sig) is what we produce for initial deliveries; courier must verify signature before mounting.
- Network: minimal outbound needed: none required for offline install. If customer enables telemetry, a single egress to telemetry.redwoodinference.com:443 via a customer-controlled bastion with mTLS is supported.

I've dropped an initial schema and example manifest in the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-offline-provenance (internal doc).

—Rishi
